priceNote: Jun 22 live · Blue Origin explosion risk easing · BB8/9/10 in orbit ✅ · Barclays cut to $60
summary: BlueBird 8/9/10 successfully launched on SpaceX Falcon 9 (Jun 17) — commercial constellation expanding. However Blue Origin New Glenn explosion (May 29) pushed back future block launches, and Barclays downgraded to Underweight with $60 target (Jun 21). Stock at $79, below our entry of $79.26. Japan J-LEO award remains the key binary catalyst for H2 2026.

catalysts.name: BlueBird 8/9/10 — In Orbit ✅

catalysts.description: Multi-billion JPY contract with Rakuten / NTT Docomo. Decision expected Q3 2026 — binary catalyst. Win = +40%+, miss = -25%.

catalysts.description: Direct-to-cell service activating across major US carriers. Subscription revenue ramp begins H2 2026. FCC authorization for SpaceMobile Service granted.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE — ค่าขนม size only. Position already open at $79.26. Hold plan: Japan J-LEO Q3 is the only reason to hold. If $68 breaks → exit.

catalystSpot.preRunup: ASTS has a history of massive pre-launch runs — BB2-7 ran from $10 → $27 before launch (+170% in 3 weeks). BB8-10 ran from $65 → $80+ pre-launch. Enter 2–3 weeks early to capture the drift. Do NOT chase on launch day — sell-the-news risk is real.

postWin.note: BB1 Apr 2024 → stock ran from $2.50 → $7.50 (+200%) in 2 weeks post-launch. BB2-7 Sep 2024 → +192% overall move. If Japan J-LEO win announced → expected +40%+

postLose.note: Blue Origin New Glenn explosion May 29, 2026 → ASTS crashed -18% in 1 day from $133 to $111. Catalyst failures are severe. Barclays PT $60 now the bear floor.

spotSizing.reason: SPECULATIVE / ค่าขนม — binary outcome, downside to $60 (Barclays), no revenue yet. Max 3% of portfolio only. Can re-size up if Japan J-LEO win is confirmed.
